name: matchlock-configurable-vfs-symbolic-link-d708
instr:
Let callers choose legacy, mount-contained, or workspace-contained symbolic-link resolution for each configured mount. Apply one containment contract from configuration through provider stacks, routing, hooks, the host protocol, and guest FUSE without exposing host paths. Existing configurations that omit a policy must behave exactly as before.

The public string policy `LinkPolicy` and `MountConfig` come from `github.com/jingkaihe/matchlock/pkg/api`; `LinkPolicyLegacy` is `"legacy"`, `LinkPolicyMount` is `"mount"`, and `LinkPolicyWorkspace` is `"workspace"`. Validation accepts those values, rejects unknown nonempty values before construction, and recursively validates both children of every overlay. Every configured memory, host, readonly, intercepted, routed, and nested overlay provider resolves relative and absolute links under its effective policy, detects cycles, preserves wrapper semantics, and prevents contained traversal or disclosure beyond the permitted boundary. Mount routing retains longest-prefix ownership and synthetic-directory behavior while distinguishing same-mount targets, sibling mounts, and workspace-external targets. Resolution hooks use `HookOpResolveLink` value `"resolve_link"`, remain distinct from creation and ordinary Readlink observations, preserve caller identity and the logical attempted path, and publish exactly one final allowed or denied outcome.
